input.reply:
I found no earlier issue requesting this. Vitest already has the pieces for this, though.

- **`setupFiles`** (`docs/config/index.md`, section `setupFiles`) runs before *each* test file. Put `beforeAll(() => { setActivePinia(createPinia()); initialiseState() })` there and every file gets the state, so you can split `CategoryA.test.ts` and `CategoryB.test.ts` freely.
- **`globalSetup`** runs once, but in the main process, not in the test workers. A Pinia instance created there is not visible to tests, which would explain your `setActivePinia` error. You can pass serializable data to tests with `provide`/`inject` (`docs/config/index.md#provide`).
- Test files are isolated by default, so in-memory state can't be shared across files. If you need that, you can use `--isolate=false`. The `setupFiles` section documents a `globalThis` guard for running setup only once in that mode. This is only for sharing state, and you'd have to make sure tests don't affect each other.

If init is cheap, per-file `setupFiles` is the simplest option.
